craft_notes: Sthāyin: 216-breath letters. Rows: even classes then count. Read aloud: steady toll.

lines: There half-watch by half-watch the tribes rise level at the crossing;
of letter, of letter, two hundred sixteen breaths; without, thirty-six beans:
l4.sanskrit_cite: tatra ardhaprahare ardhaprahare vargodayo viṣuvati samaḥ varṇasya varṇasya dve śate ṣoḍaśādhike prāṇānām bahiḥ ṣaṭtriṃśat caṣakāṇi iti udayaḥ ayam ayatnajo varṇodayaḥ
